newsitem.title: NETHERLANDS: ABN AMRO acquires stake in S-African broker.
newsitem.headline: ABN AMRO acquires stake in S-African broker.

text.p: ABN AMRO Bank said on Thursday its unit ABN AMRO Hoare Govett had acquired a 40 percent stake in the South African broker Huysamer Stals together with Kasogo Financial Services.
The biggest shareholders in KSF are NM Rothschilds & Sons and Kasigo Trust Investment Company in South Africa.
ABN AMRO also said it had acquired a minority stake in KFS.
